mcp_redis_fixes.issue: MCP Redis hangs during hot cache ingestion
root_causes: MCP timeout configuration too short for large operations
Redis batch operations taking too long for MCP timeouts
No progress reporting during long operations
Memory issues with large ADG datasets
Redis server configuration not optimized for large datasets

recommended_fixes.description: Extend timeouts for Redis operations to 5-10 minutes
recommended_fixes.implementation: Configure MCP server with longer timeout values

recommended_fixes.fix: Implement batch processing with progress reporting
recommended_fixes.description: Break large ingestion into smaller batches with progress updates
recommended_fixes.implementation: Modify adg_redis_ingest.py to process in chunks

recommended_fixes.description: Configure Redis for large dataset operations
recommended_fixes.implementation: Set maxmemory and optimize Redis config

recommended_fixes.description: Use async Redis operations to prevent blocking
recommended_fixes.implementation: Use redis-py async or implement background processing

mcp_redis_fixes.workaround: Use direct Python scripts instead of MCP for large Redis operations
